clock: PostgreSQL clock_timestamp after connector lock and after receipt/audit before commit
revision: Admin monotonic context and fence; receipt replay does not advance
atomicity: snapshot+page relations+current identity+current policy status+terminal run+receipt+audit
legacy: old snapshot/identity/status writes denied by new ingress; ownerless syncing unresolved; drain all old Dream/Admin instances before default-closed claim gate opens
cache: Dream commits Admin first, writes isolated accepted versions and validates full current connector/version identity on every read

actor_lock.execute: only exact DATA role; not PUBLIC/auth/control/Dream
actor_lock.owner: migration owner; DATA cannot replace or own
actor_lock.locks: FOR SHARE OF identity.subject_links, public.users, public.platform_users until outer UOW commit
